name: capability-rows
description: Capability rows: tinted, outlined rows with an icon and title on the left and a description and explore link on the right, plus an optional closing line with a button. Live: #ap-gov-solution on the industry hubs.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

items.description: Rows. Each: title (required), body, link_label, url, tone (indigo, green, yellow, blue, red, cyan); icon (URL) or icon_svg. A row may carry number (shown instead of the icon).

ender_accent.description: Part of the closing heading painted with the gradient.

plain.description: Drop the tinted card and keep only the coloured left rule (the platform page job list).

variant.description: readiness: the Emergency Preparedness / School Reunification list (427px title column, rows side by side down to 1001px). eduhub: the Education hub's capability list (live #ap-eduhub-solution, ported whole).

stack.description: Width at which the layout stacks: 1024px (the hubs) or 900px (the Education hub).
